mapper.insert: INSERT INTO mes_aps_lh_mold_adjust_plan( id, mold_order_no, lh_machine_code, plan_date, before_sap_code, before_embryo_code, before_spec_desc, tire_rough_stock, use_mold_number, left_right_mold, change_type, after_sap_code, after_embryo_code, after_spec_desc, change_mold_time, data_source, remark, DATA_VERSION , CREATE_DATE , UPDATE_DATE , IS_DELETE , FACTORY_CODE, COMPANY_CODE) WITH construction AS ( SELECT max(sap_code) sap_code, embryo_code FROM T_CONSTRUCTION_VERSION_INFO c WHERE c.del_flag = '0' GROUP BY embryo_code ) SELECT id, mold_order_no, lh_machine_code, plan_date, before_sap_code, C1.sap_code before_embryo_code,/*胎胚品号，MES要求接口传品号*/ before_spec_desc, tire_rough_stock, use_mold_number, left_right_mold, change_type, after_sap_code, C2.sap_code after_embryo_code,/*胎胚品号，MES要求接口传品号*/ after_spec_desc, change_mold_time, data_source, remark, #{dataVersion} DATA_VERSION, sysdate CREATE_DATE , UPDATE_TIME UPDATE_DATE , DEL_FLAG IS_DELETE, #{factoryCode}, #{companyCode} FROM t_aps_lh_mold_adjust_plan p INNER JOIN construction c1 ON c1.embryo_code = p.before_embryo_code INNER JOIN construction c2 ON c2.embryo_code = p.After_Embryo_Code WHERE id in #{id}
